icy_lib:critical_strike_chance.desc: Chance to deal critical strike, multiplying damage by 1.5x. 1 point = 1% chance.
icy_lib:defense.desc: Reduces damage taken. Actual damage = original damage - defense value.
icy_lib:critical_strike_defense.desc: Reduces chance of being critically hit. Attacker's crit chance = (crit - crit defense)%.
icy_lib:physical_resistance.desc: Reduces physical damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ physical resistance ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:elemental_resistance.desc: Reduces elemental damage taken as a universal elemental resistance multiplier.
icy_lib:universal_resistance.desc: Reduces all damage taken except Punishing damage.
icy_lib:ice_resistance.desc: Reduces ice damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (ice resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:fire_resistance.desc: Reduces fire damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (fire resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:light_resistance.desc: Reduces light damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (light resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:shadow_resistance.desc: Reduces shadow damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (shadow resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:magic_resistance.desc: Reduces magic damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (magic resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:poison_resistance.desc: Reduces poison damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ (poison resistance × elemental resistance) ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:void_resistance.desc: Reduces void damage taken. Actual damage = original ÷ void resistance ÷ universal resistance - defense.
icy_lib:critical_strike_multiplier_add.d: Critical strike damage bonus (additive), base critical damage is 150%.
icy_lib:critical_strike_multiplier_multi: Critical strike damage bonus (multiplicative), stacks with additive bonus.
effect.icy_lib.fortitude.description: Knockback immunity, removes negative effects every second
effect.icy_lib.rage.description: Normal attack extra damage bonus increased by 20%
effect.icy_lib.catherine_shield.descript: Gain 1000 shield and 15% physical damage bonus
